name: com.example.isw_smart_till.service.bluetooth.TillBluetoothReceiver$Companion$BluetoothSDKBroadcastReceiver
description: Runs when the Interswitch Smart Till SDK reports a Bluetooth connection change or receives a terminal message. It passes connection status, errors and transaction replies to the app.
disableEffect: The app may not receive Bluetooth till status or transaction replies, so payments through that terminal can fail.
